title: Crossett Coastal Rental | Loaded 30A Estate | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Crossett Coastal Cottage is a designer 30A retreat with a private pool, golf cart, bikes, fenced yard, and quick access to the beach and Seaside.
description_expanded: Crossett Coastal Cottage Designer Retreat with Private Pool and Golf Cart Near Seaside Home Introduction Welcome to Crossett Coastal Cottage , a stylish designer home just minutes from the beach and Seaside . Featuring a private pool, LSV (golf cart), and multiple indoor and outdoor living spaces , this home is perfectly designed for families and groups looking to enjoy the best of 30A in comfort and style. Home Highlights Private Pool - Tanning shelf perfect for lounging and younger guests Pool Heating Included - Available for arrivals October 1 through April 30 Beach Access - 1-minute bike ride to 395 Beach Access with beach service available Taxi Bikes - 5 Taxi bikes included and professionally maintained LSV Included - 6-seater low-speed vehicle serviced by La Dolce Vita (waiver required) Outdoor Living - Covered patio with dining area, Smart TV, and summer kitchen with built-in gas grill Fenced Backyard - AstroTurf yard ideal for games and family fun Sundeck - Poolside seating plus outdoor shower Gourmet Kitchen - High-end stainless steel appliances plus wet bar with ice maker Smart Living - Smart TVs, cable, WiFi, and Sonos sound system Main Living Area - Located on first floor with comfortable seating (fireplace not available) Second Floor Bonus Spaces - Kitchenette with mini fridge and microwave plus kids loft with TV Laundry - High-efficiency washer and dryer on second floor Parking - Driveway space for 3 vehicles Location Perks 4-minute bike ride to Seaside Town Center for shopping, dining, and food trucks 2 blocks to Surfing Deer and Seagrove Village Market Quick access to Scenic 30A beaches and bike paths Close proximity to local dining, shopping, and entertainment Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for reservations of 10 days or longer (included in your stay) Additional cleanings can be scheduled for an extra fee Pool heating is included seasonally for qualifying reservations LSV access requires signed waiver Concierge services available including grocery delivery, private chef, beach setups, and baby equipment rentals Nearby construction and community projects may occur; refunds are not provided for related disturbances Home Overview Crossett Coastal Cottage offers the perfect blend of modern design and relaxed beach living, just three blocks from the sand . Thoughtfully designed with high-end finishes and stylish décor , this home creates a welcoming and comfortable atmosphere for your entire group. The first-floor living area serves as the heart of the home, featuring a spacious layout ideal for gathering after a day at the beach. The gourmet kitchen is fully equipped for everything from quick breakfasts to family dinners, with an adjacent dining area and breakfast bar for additional seating. Step outside into your private backyard retreat , where a pool with tanning shelf, covered dining area, and outdoor kitchen create the ultimate space for entertaining. The fenced AstroTurf yard provides a safe and fun area for kids to play while adults relax poolside. Upstairs, additional amenities like a kitchenette and a dedicated kids loft provide extra flexibility and space for everyone to spread out. With its unbeatable location near the beach, Seaside, and local dining favorites , Crossett Coastal Cottage delivers a true 30A experience-equal parts luxury, convenience, and laid-back coastal charm.
